Initial no-growth baseline for issue #10934 and Epic #10920. The epic reference remains fixed at fe18b2f004e2304c52db33cf7bb5895828197f9a. Current main is lower because #10722 removed the live Shields assertion suites before this ratchet landed. PR #10341 adds the accepted public deferred-install and same-home credential continuation boundary for Hermes and Deep Agents Code; existing per-file budgets remain unchanged. PR #13055 adds five explicitly approved assertions for the native Deep Agents Code OpenRouter request in the existing hosted OpenRouter target. PR #13293 consolidates native-local cases into the existing OpenClaw switching owner. Removing duplicated deterministic metadata and direct mock requests lowers suite totals while retaining real authenticated and sentinel agent turns, lifecycle, model switching, credential isolation and sibling denial. Per-file transitive counts include existing imported helpers; no live files or suite assertion points are added.

PR #13596 adds four assertions to the existing double-onboard target for #13595: the managed OpenClaw state volume exists before `nemoclaw uninstall`, uninstall succeeds, the volume is gone afterwards, and same-name onboarding succeeds.

PR #14000 adds one approved assertion point for owning-gateway connect session detection in concurrent-gateway-ports. The list command exit check replaces the redundant CLI build-file check; the existing --version prerequisite verifies that the compiled CLI runs. Approval: https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw/pull/14000#issuecomment-6506269922.

PR #13607 adds two live assertions and one read-only configuration probe to the existing balanced OpenClaw egress case for unavailable-search replies. The refreshed delta removes the unrelated public-fetch precondition guard while retaining both live assertions and the probe. Approved delta: https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw/pull/13607#issuecomment-6327887365.

User-approved exception on 2026-11-03: PR #12603 repairs the existing MCP credential absence scan. One input guard and five generated probe blocks with eight conditions reject empty credentials, early credential matches, unreadable paths and grep errors. Existing scan call sites and timeouts remain unchanged.

User-approved assertion-accounting exception on 2026-11-03: PR #12603 makes the existing snapshot residue check fail when the directory cannot be read. The replacement adds one counted generated block, one condition, and one MCP transitive block. The former one-line shell expression was not counted. Runtime deadlines and coverage remain unchanged.

User-approved exception on 2026-11-04: PR #12603 adds two identity assertions to the existing managed-image activation cleanup. They require a valid sandbox identity and a nonempty cleanup scope before checking runtime-owned control volumes. Existing lifecycle coverage and runtime deadlines remain unchanged.

PR #14122 replaces managed-vLLM binding-shape checks with direct allowed-address and denied-address requests. Source tests retain the default/custom port and authentication permutations; runtime inspection remains in the artifacts.
The same PR adds the production bearerless provider-validation proof to the existing inference-routing target. The combined change adds two assertion points and one runtime probe, approved at https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw/pull/14122#issuecomment-6596327330.
